quests.title: Mimi Tomo

dialogue.t: Traveler! Please, over here.
Apologies, but I need a moment of your time. Would you be interested in taking on a new commission?

dialogue.sit: Can't hurt to learn more about it.

dialogue.t: The situation is this. The Guild has recently received several reports that the hilichurls in the wild are once again starting to band together and disrupt the merchant route.
We have dispatched a significant number of adventurers to investigate...
All of whom have reported a strange phenomenon — that whenever they discover a group of hilichurls gathering together, there is always a certain unusual hilichurl in their midst...
We believe that this "Unusual Hilichurl" could be a key factor in the recent disturbances.
So, we require someone to capture the Unusual Hilichurl, or at the very least chase it away.
Traveler, are you interested in accepting this commission?

dialogue.sit: I will keep my eyes open when I'm out and about.

dialogue.t: Thank you! I have marked some locations for you on your Map.
Hilichurl activity has been reported in each of these areas. Please begin your investigation by visiting them.
Should you encounter the Unusual Hilichurl... Please exercise due caution.
Phew... That was close. Good thing you came when you did...
*sigh*...
I don't understand, everything was going so well... What was it that I said?
Well, anyway... Thank you for saving me...
She looks really upset...
Well... You saw what happened.
My previous strategy of attempting to interact with hilichurls on my own is manifestly too risky...
But still... It's a shame for a golden opportunity to converse with a hilichurl to just go to waste...

dialogue.sit: Is there anything I can do?

dialogue.t: It looks like my vocabulary compilation work for the dictionary is going to have to be postponed once again...
If only I had someone who could verify the accuracy of the book's contents on my behalf...
R—Really? That's great! ...Right then, be sure to take this book with you!
Wow... That was a fast transition from sulking to bossing us around...
If you encounter any communication difficulties, you'll be able to resolve them simply by consulting this book! ...In principle, at least.
You mean you don't even know what you wrote in your own book!?
You only find out where the problems in your research lie through real-world application! Without putting them through their paces, how am I supposed to know for sure whether my theories hold water?
Hmm... Nope, never mind, you probably wouldn't understand what I was about to say anyway. But that aside... thank you, once again, for saving me.
Now, if you don't mind, I will join you. Let's go find a hilichurl to interact with.

dialogue.sit: Now, if you don't mind, I will join you. Let's go find a hilichurl to interact with.

quests.description: The Adventurers’ Guild has issued a new commission, and it seems to be related to a certain “Unusual Hilichurl”…?
